body:
ADVISOR RULING. Operator instruction 2026-11-15 23:36 MST. Effective now.

The review-round cap is 4, not 2. This amends item 2 of the 2026-10-14 throughput ruling.

- A PR may go through up to 4 rounds of REQUEST CHANGES. Rounds 3 and 4 are ordinary rounds: re-review the new head as usual.
- Only after round 4 does the reviewing seat stop and mail the advisor. The advisor then merges with the leftover items filed as follow-up specs, or parks the PR.
- Until TASK-3808 lands, the review watcher still says "two-round review cap reached" after round 2. That message is wrong now. Do not act on it. Launch round 3 or 4 by hand: `aida queue work PR-N --auto-complete` through the deputy.
- TASK-3808 makes the cap a project setting. The default stays 2, and this project sets 4.
subject: ADVISOR RULING: review-round cap is 4 (was 2)
